title: Why You Wake Up Starving Even After Eating Dinner
hook: Why do you wake up suddenly hungry, even after a big dinner?

narration.text: Your body's hunger hormones, ghrelin and leptin, operate on a precise daily schedule.
Ghrelin, the hunger-signalling hormone, peaks in the early morning.
This happens regardless of when you last ate or the size of your evening meal.
Meanwhile, leptin, which signals fullness, dips overnight.
This hormonal shift means you are biologically primed to feel hungry upon waking.
It is a built-in mechanism, ensuring you seek food to break your overnight fast.
So, that morning hunger is often not about your last meal, but your hormones.
Have you noticed this intense morning hunger yourself?

description: Ever wonder why you wake up feeling absolutely ravenous, even if you had a substantial meal the night before? It is all down to your body's clever hormonal cycles of ghrelin and leptin. Discover the fascinating biological reason behind your morning appetite.
topic: Why you suddenly wake up feeling hungry even if you ate before bed, explaining ghrelin and leptin cycles.
